title: 神戸石炭訴訟へのご支援ありがとうございました
title_en: Thank you for your support in the Kobe Coal lawsuit
contents: 神戸石炭訴訟原告・弁護団は、2つの判決を受けて、2025年11月29日、訴訟活動の終了を確認し、解散することとしました。2018年9月の提訴から7年。「気候変動を防ぐ、大気汚染を防ぐ、そして子どもたちに未来をつなぐ。」――そんな市民の願いを胸に、日本で初めての本格的な気候変動訴訟としてスタートしました。アーカイブとして掲載している神戸石炭行政訴訟は、2023年3月9日、最高裁判所は上告を棄却・却下となりました。残念ながら、私たちの訴えは退けられました。民事訴訟も同様に厳しい結果となりましたが、訴訟を通じて私たちは社会に「石炭火力と気候危機」という問題を広く問いかけることができました。裁判の場では、気候変動がもたらす被害の深刻さ、行政の審査の不十分さ、市民の健康と未来への影響を具体的に示してきました。これらの記録は、今後の気候訴訟や政策議論に活かされる大切な財産となります。感謝とこれから裁判の結果は厳しいものでしたが、私たちはこの訴訟で得た経験を次の一歩につなげます。司法の限界を感じつつも、市民が声を上げ、記録し、社会へ問うことの意味を改めて確信しました。今後、原告・弁護団、訴訟事務局を務めた神戸の石炭火力発電を考える会において、本ページに記録されている裁判資料、これまでの市民運動、裁判に関する記録誌を編纂する予定です。気候危機は続いています。神戸から始まったこの訴訟の思いを、これからも市民一人ひとりの行動へ、そして次の世代へとつないでいきます。こうした思いを具現化する動きがすでに生まれています。 名古屋地裁では、若者を中心に構成された原告団が、神戸製鋼所・関西電力らを被告として、1.5℃目標と整合する削減計画の実行を求める「若者気候訴訟」を2024年8月に提起しました。神戸石炭訴訟の原告・弁護団は、この若者気候訴訟を後に続く訴訟としてサポートするべく、関係者による傍聴支援や交流を実施しています。神戸で私たちが切り拓いた気候訴訟の経験が、次の世代へと受け継がれています。ぜひ、若者気候訴訟にご注目いただけますと幸いです。そして、長きにわたるご支援とご関心に、心より感謝申し上げます。
contents_en: Following the two rulings, the plaintiffs and legal team in the Kobe Coal lawsuit have decided to confirm the end of their litigation activities and disband on November 29, 2025. Seven years have passed since the lawsuit was filed in September 2018. "Prevent climate change, prevent air pollution, and pass on the future to our children." With these citizens' wishes in mind, this lawsuit was launched as Japan's first full-scale climate change lawsuit. In the Kobe Coal Administrative Lawsuit, which is posted as an archive, the Supreme Court dismissed the appeal on March 9, 2023. Unfortunately, our lawsuit was dismissed. The civil lawsuit also had a harsh outcome, but through the lawsuit we were able to raise awareness in society about the issue of "coal-fired power generation and the climate crisis." In court, we have concretely demonstrated the seriousness of the damage caused by climate change, the inadequacy of administrative review, and the impact on citizens' health and future. These records will be an important asset that can be used in future climate litigation and policy discussions. Gratitude and the future Although the outcome of the trial was harsh, we will use the experience we gained from this lawsuit to take our next step. While we felt the limitations of the judicial system, we were once again convinced of the importance of citizens speaking out, recording their experiences, and questioning society. Going forward, the plaintiffs, their legal team, and the Kobe Association for Considering Coal-fired Power Plants , which served as the lawsuit secretariat, plan to compile a record of the court documents recorded on this page, as well as the citizen movements and court cases to date. The climate crisis continues. We will continue to pass on the message of this lawsuit, which began in Kobe, to the actions of each and every citizen, and to future generations. Movements to put these messages into practice are already underway. In August 2024, a group of plaintiffs, primarily composed of young people, filed the " Youth Climate Lawsuit " in the Nagoya District Court, suing Kobe Steel, Kansai Electric Power Company, and others as defendants, demanding the implementation of a reduction plan consistent with the 1.5°C target. The plaintiffs and lawyers in the Kobe Coal Lawsuit are supporting the Youth Climate Lawsuit by organizing meetings and providing support for the trial to encourage future lawsuits. The experience of climate litigation that we pioneered in Kobe is being passed on to the next generation. We hope you will pay attention to the Youth Climate Lawsuit. We would like to express our sincere gratitude for your long-standing support and interest.
